title: The Scientific Method · Step-by-step Flow
description: How a scientist moves from a curiosity to a confident answer. Each step feeds into the next.

nodes.label: Observe
nodes.detail: Watch and record what is happening.

nodes.label: Form a hypothesis
nodes.detail: A testable idea that might explain it.

nodes.label: Run a fair experiment
nodes.detail: Change one thing; keep everything else the same.

nodes.label: Record results
nodes.detail: Measure carefully and write it down honestly.

nodes.label: Does the data support the idea?
nodes.detail: Compare your results with your hypothesis.

nodes.label: Conclude & share
nodes.detail: Share so others can repeat or extend the work.

nodes.label: Refine hypothesis
nodes.detail: Tweak your idea or design and try again.
